title: Add values to an existing sparse column in place — add_assign_col_inplace
code: if (requireNamespace("Matrix", quietly = TRUE)) {   x <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = 4, ncol = 2, sparse = TRUE)   x[1, 1] <- 1   x[3, 1] <- 2   # value is the same length as i   add_assign_col_inplace(x, i = c(1L, 3L), j = 1L, value = c(10, -5)) } #> 4 x 2 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix" #>           #> [1,] 11 . #> [2,]  . . #> [3,] -3 . #> [4,]  . .
